I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock, so I can’t give you the exact time right now.  
If you need the current time in New York City, you can:

* Check the clock on your phone, computer, or smart‑watch (most devices automatically adjust for time zones).
* Use an online world‑clock tool or a time‑zone converter (e.g., “New York City time” in a search engine).
* Ask a voice assistant like Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa.

These methods will give you the precise local time in New York City at the moment you check.
